name: The Button Moon Control Room
description: A retro-futuristic control room with giant buttons and levers operates a glowing crescent moon.
prompt: Whimsical control room with a huge crescent moon visible through a round window, giant colorful buttons and brass levers on a curved console, a small astronaut cat floating, star charts without letters, warm retro-futuristic lighting, detailed illustration, no text, no logos.
caption: Someone has to press the button that makes the moon glow. 🌙🔘
